data.name: Grid carbon
data.description: GB grid carbon intensity signals for carbon-aware scheduling: now, a half-hourly forecast, and the cleanest window to run a job. Supported by National Energy SO Open Data. Not provided or endorsed by NESO.

endpoints.summary: Countries covered, with forecast freshness and the paid endpoints for each
Grid carbon intensity now (gCO2/kWh), the next half-hour, and how now compares with the next 24 h

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: GB country whose grid carbon intensity to read (NESO country forecast)

endpoints.summary: Half-hourly carbon intensity forecast from now

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: GB country whose grid carbon intensity to read (NESO country forecast)

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Horizon in hours (1-48, default 24)

endpoints.summary: Cleanest time to run a job: the lowest-carbon contiguous window, and the saving versus starting now

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: GB country whose grid carbon intensity to read (NESO country forecast)

parameters.name: duration_h
parameters.description: Job length in hours, in half-hour steps (0.5-12)

parameters.name: within_h
parameters.description: Must finish within this many hours (duration_h-48, default 24)

endpoints.summary: Point-in-time history: for each half-hour in a range, the forecast as it stood at as_of (default now), with when we first knew it

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: GB country whose grid carbon intensity to read (NESO country forecast)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Range start, ISO 8601 with a zone (e.g. 2026-11-07T00:00:00Z)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Range end (exclusive), at most 7 days after from; default from + 24 h

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Knowledge time: only versions known by then (default now; not in the future)

endpoints.summary: Every version of one half-hour's forecast, oldest first: how the forecast for that period changed

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: GB country whose grid carbon intensity to read (NESO country forecast)

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Half-hour start, ISO 8601 with a zone, on :00 or :30

endpoints.summary: Server-sent events: the current forecast on connect, then each new version as it lands. Charged per event from an x402 session

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: GB country whose grid carbon intensity to read (NESO country forecast)
